name: Credible - reputable + sources
title: Health agency releases updated guidance on seasonal flu vaccinations
text: According to the official statement, the guidance is based on a review of multiple studies (doi:10.0000/example). The report outlines updated recommendations and cites peer-reviewed research.

name: Needs verification - extraordinary claim but evidence cues
title: Researchers report surprising result in lab experiment
text: According to a study published in a journal, the authors describe an unexpected outcome. Source: the paper includes a DOI and links to datasets.

name: Needs verification - numbers without source
title: New policy will reduce taxes by 37% and increase salaries by 22%
text: The policy will change 12 sectors, create 500000 jobs in 3 months, and increase GDP by 4.5%. Details are unclear and sources say it will happen soon.
